Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 25

“In front of Bhishma, Drona, and all the rulers of the earth, Krishna said: O Partha, behold these assembled Kurus.”

Krishna's words are almost clinically simple — "behold these Kurus" — a plain instruction that will trigger an overwhelming emotional collapse in Arjuna over the following verses.
